system.name: P4RTC
system.one_liner: a system that extends P4 to program run-to-completion (RTC) network chips via a new architecture model, compiler backend, and toolchain

components.name: RX / TX MAC
components.role: receives incoming packets and transmits outgoing packets at the chip's network ports

components.name: Dispatcher
components.role: selects an idle foreground core and assigns it an incoming packet

components.name: Cores
components.role: the chip's pool of independent cores, each running its own P4-defined logical pipeline

components.name: Foreground
components.role: cores running the user's foreground_pipe package to parse, process, and forward received packets

components.name: C1
components.role: an example foreground core executing ingress1's table1.apply() check

components.name: C2
components.role: an example foreground core concurrently executing ingress1's counter.count()

components.name: Background
components.role: cores running the user's background_pipe package independently of packet arrivals

components.name: Cb
components.role: an example background core looping ingress2/deparser2 to periodically clear the counter

components.name: Reorder
components.role: restores per-flow packet ordering across the many parallel cores before the traffic manager

components.name: Traffic Manager
components.role: queues and schedules reordered packets to the output port

components.name: Memory
components.role: the chip's shared memory system reachable by all cores

components.name: Table 1
components.role: an example on-chip match-action table declared in the P4 program

components.name: Counter
components.role: an example on-chip counter extern shared by multiple cores

components.name: Other Tables & Counters
components.role: additional match-action tables and counters kept off-chip

components.name: P4 Code
components.role: example P4 source showing the foreground/background pipeline split with per-line core annotations (C1, C2, Cb)

content.key_idea: P4RTC compiles ordinary P4 control blocks into independent packet-triggered foreground cores and free-running background cores that share on-/off-chip tables and counters; per-line code annotations (C1, C2, Cb) show exactly which core runs which statement.
content.reading_order: Top row left-to-right traces a packet through RX/TX MAC, Dispatcher, Cores, Reorder, Traffic Manager; the bottom row expands Cores/Memory and the P4 Code whose C1/C2/Cb arrows map lines to cores.

encoding.color_means: navy blue marks foreground (packet-triggered) cores, orange marks background (free-running) cores; light green headers mark the code/memory panels and light blue marks the cores panel; gray boxes are the fixed (non-programmable) pipeline hardware
encoding.line_style_means: solid blue arrows show the packet path through fixed hardware; dashed black arrows labeled R/W/R&W show which cores read or write which memory locations; small labeled arrows (C1, C2, Cb) tie specific P4 statements to the core that executes them
encoding.emphasis: the C1/C2/Cb annotations directly on the P4 source make the many-core execution model concrete by showing, line by line, which core runs what and how cores share the same Counter
reusable_patterns: annotated source code linked by labeled arrows to the hardware units executing each line
foreground/background core split sharing a common on-chip/off-chip memory hierarchy

summary: Figure 4 illustrates P4RTC's many-core programming abstraction using one packet's path plus an annotated code example. Along the top, packets enter via RX/TX MAC, and the Dispatcher selects an idle Foreground core to run the user's foreground_pipe; Reorder then restores packet order from all cores before the Traffic Manager transmits them. The bottom row zooms in: Cores holds many Foreground cores (C1, C2, ...) alongside independent Background cores (Cb, ...) that loop the background_pipe without waiting for packets; Memory holds on-chip Table 1 and a Counter plus off-chip Other Tables & Counters. The P4 Code panel shows ingress1 (annotated C1 for table1.apply(), C2 for counter.count()) and ingress2 (annotated Cb for the periodic counter.clear()), with dashed arrows marking C1 reading Table 1, C2 read-writing the Counter, and Cb writing that same Counter.
summary_zh: 该图展示P4RTC多核编程抽象:数据包经MAC与Dispatcher分发至前台核心,经Reorder、Traffic Manager发出;后台核心独立循环;P4代码用C1/C2/Cb标注各行对应核心及对片上表/计数器的读写。
